title: a UTF-16 export is read as UTF-16
line: the harness tree written in UTF-16, little-endian with a byte order mark and its header's CHAR UNICODE, ingests the same 30 people with every stored text as the file writes it, none of it replaced

steps.say: the harness file as an exporter that writes UTF-16 would write it

expect.why: the same 30 people the file in UTF-8 gives
every text is the file's own, none replaced
